original_prompt: Write a Kubernetes Service manifest exposing a Deployment named 'api-server' on port 80 internally to other cluster services.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Kubernetes manifest (YAML)

Task: Write a Kubernetes Service manifest exposing a Deployment named 'api-server' on port 80 internally to other cluster services.

Output only the Kubernetes manifest (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: api-server
  namespace: default
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: api-server
    app.kubernetes.io/component: api
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: api-server
  annotations:
    description: "Internal ClusterIP service exposing the api-server Deployment to other cluster workloads."
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: api-server
    app.kubernetes.io/component: api
  ports:
    - name: http
      protocol: TCP
      port: 80
      targetPort: http
  sessionAffinity: None
  internalTrafficPolicy: Cluster
  ipFamilyPolicy: SingleStack
  ipFamilies:
    - IPv4
